info.name: YouTube Clone - Video Summarization API
info.description: AI-powered video summarization using AssemblyAI and Google Gemini

request.description:
Submit a video for AI summarization

Process:
1. Submits video URL to AssemblyAI for transcription
2. Polls AssemblyAI until transcription is complete
3. Retrieves the full transcript
4. Sends transcript to Google Gemini for summary generation
5. Stores summary and transcript in MongoDB
6. Returns the generated summary

Expected Response Time: 30-120 seconds (depends on video length)

Status Codes:
- 200: Summary generated successfully
- 400: Invalid video ID or missing video URL
- 404: Video not found
- 408: Transcription polling timeout
- 500: Server error

response.name: Success Response

request.description:
Retrieve a previously generated summary for a video

Note: Summary must be generated first using the POST endpoint

Status Codes:
- 200: Summary retrieved successfully
- 400: Invalid video ID format
- 404: Video not found OR summary not generated yet
- 500: Server error
